target_customer: Individual knowledge workers, researchers and developers who want a private AI assistant
problem: Searching and reasoning over personal notes, documents and the web with an assistant the user controls.
business_model: Open source with paid cloud subscription (cloud later sunset)

founders.name: Debanjum Singh Solanky
founders.background_notes: Started Khoj as an open-source side project for Org-mode note search (per one directory); helped create Hillhacks.

founders.name: Saba Imran
prior_employers: a YC biotech startup (name not given)

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval over local notes with LLM chat across multiple clients (Emacs, Obsidian, web); standard engineering with model integration.

defensibility.rationale: AGPL open source and many similar document chat tools; copyable quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large platforms shipped assistants and memory; the hosted Khoj Cloud was reportedly sunset on 2026-04-15 per a single review site.

market_need_then: Interest in private, self-hosted LLM assistants rose with the 2023 wave of generative AI; hard demand figures not found.

branding.name_origin: Khoj is a Hindi word meaning search, discovery or exploration per dictionary-style sources; the founders' own reasoning is not stated.

identity.voice_and_tone: Lowercase tagline 'ai for humans'; calls itself a tiny team of hackers

branding.brand_signature: 'ai for humans' tagline and building in the open
branding.community_and_virality: GitHub sponsors page and open-source community listings exist; scale of community not verified.

brand_strength.rationale: Open-source project with directory and review coverage and a meaningful name, but no brand-level press found.

pivots.from: Hosted personal AI second brain (Khoj Cloud)
pivots.to: Open-source self-hosting plus new products Open Paper and Pipali
pivots.why: Reason not public; sunset reported by one review site

outcome_analysis: Khoj is a two-person open-source applied AI team with strong technical founders from Microsoft and Two Sigma. Funding appears limited to the YC deal and Pioneer Fund per aggregators. One review site reports the cloud service ended in April 2026 while open source continues, and the site now lists Open Paper and Pipali. The record shows a durable project but no clear venture-scale outcome.
notes: Funding of 500K at about 990K valuation from YC and Pioneer Fund is from aggregators only and unverified, so no round recorded. Khoj Cloud sunset on 2026-04-15 comes from one review site and is unverified. Directories date the first release to 2021; founded_year uses the YC batch year. Sources disagree on batch (W23 vs S23); the directory says Summer 2023. No dated competitor sources found.
